name: Read a member's account balance
description: Look up a member in Meridian Core Servicing and return the balance and status of one of their accounts.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: The member number to look up.

inputs.name: account_type
inputs.description: Which of the member's accounts to report on.

outputs.name: balance
outputs.description: Current balance of the requested account.

outputs.name: account_status
outputs.description: Status of the requested account, e.g. Open.

steps.intent: Enter the member number to search for.
